en.headline: Buildings Department finds One Stanley steel work does not match approved plans
en.dek: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said the investigation is largely complete and the department will consult the Justice Department on possible prosecution.
body: Development Secretary Bernadette Linn told the Legislative Council on Wednesday that the Buildings Department has largely completed its investigation into steel reinforcement at a house in the One Stanley luxury development in Stanley. Some wire mesh and steel configurations did not match the approved plans and the discrepancies had never been reported to the authorities.

The department will consult the Department of Justice on possible prosecution. It has also ordered random inspections of 15 other houses and 12 units in six residential blocks at the estate. The developer must appoint independent accredited laboratories to carry out the tests under official supervision.

Linn said enforcement action would be taken if further violations are found. In response to the case, contractors will in future be required to photograph or video steel reinforcement work before concrete is poured and submit the records for checking.
The investigation began after an owner complained that the amount of steel used in parts of one house fell short of the approved drawings. Earlier department checks had found no immediate danger.

zh.headline: 屋宇署指赤柱ONE STANLEY鋼筋配置與圖則不符 將徵詢律政司檢控意見
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示調查大致完成，署方已勒令抽查屋苑其他單位，並計劃要求承建商灌注混凝土前拍照或錄像記錄鋼筋。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周三在立法會表示，屋宇署已大致完成對赤柱豪宅ONE STANLEY一間獨立屋鋼筋工程的調查。部分鋼絲網及鋼筋配置與批准圖則不符，相關差異從未向當局申報。
署方將向律政司徵詢可能檢控的意見。同時已勒令抽查該屋苑另外15間獨立屋及6座住宅大樓內的12個單位，要求發展商委聘獨立認可實驗所在當局監督下進行測試。
甯漢豪指，若發現違規將採取執法行動。因應事件，日後承建商在灌注混凝土前須以相片或錄像記錄鋼筋配置，並提交紀錄供抽查。
調查源於一名業主投訴，指屋內部分位置所用鋼筋數量少於批准圖則。署方較早前檢查未發現即時危險。
